title: React Interview Bomb Challenge
description: Beat the clock! You have only 5 seconds per question to answer these high-pressure React interview questions. Avoid the explosion!

questions.question: Which hook is used for component side effects?
questions.explanation: useEffect is designed specifically to run side effects (fetching data, subscriptions, manually changing the DOM) in functional components after rendering.

questions.question: What memoizes a computed value between renders?
questions.explanation: useMemo memoizes the computed RESULT of a function, whereas useCallback memoizes the FUNCTION itself to prevent recreation.

questions.question: What triggers a component re-render in React?
questions.explanation: State modifications (via updater functions) tell React to re-render the component. Changing useRef values does NOT trigger re-renders.

questions.question: Where are Next.js static files stored?
questions.explanation: In Next.js, static files like images or fonts are served out of a folder named public in the root directory.

questions.question: Can React components return multiple root elements directly?
questions.explanation: React components must return a single root element. To return multiple sibling elements, you must wrap them in a Fragment (<>...</>) or array.
